chronology_notes: Heft 7 was printed in 1968 and reported observations from 1966. Earlier Folge I-II were reported as containing 1963-1964 observations by the 1965 Baja yearbook (L39), not found here. The 3-page PDF consists of a preface and two title-page facsimiles, not the complete Heft 7.
follow_up: Locate complete INTEROBS Folge I-II (1964-1965) and their List 1 / List 2 pages, identify dates including 1963-11-07 through 1963-11-09 and object designation before use. Investigate the stated Soviet publication successor as a separate bibliographic route; do not equate its Soviet-title semantics with observation of US 1963-003A/B/C.
